parts.desc: HEAD 下面是你当前分支上这行的内容
parts.desc_en: Below HEAD is this line on the branch you are currently on.

parts.desc: 这部分来自当前分支；来源标记不代表整段都该保留，先结合页面用途判断
parts.desc_en: This part came from the current branch; its source marker does not mean the whole section should be kept. Check the page context.

parts.desc: 两版内容的分界，解决冲突时和标记一起删掉
parts.desc_en: The divider between the two versions; delete it with the markers.

parts.desc: 这部分来自被合入的分支；先看改动用途，来源标记不代表它对或错
parts.desc_en: This part came from the branch being merged; check what it does because the source marker does not say whether it is right.

parts.desc: 标出这段内容来自哪条分支，方便追溯
parts.desc_en: Marks which branch this content came from, for traceability.

variants.en: Use needed content from one side
variants.when: 确认一边的改动不再需要后，才删除对应内容
variants.when_en: After confirming one side's change is no longer needed, remove that content

variants.demo: <h1>小狸的摄影主页</h1><p>城市风景集</p>
variants.when: 把两边仍有用的内容整理成符合当前页面需求的结果
variants.when_en: Combine useful changes from both sides into the result the page needs

variants.when: 冲突太复杂、需要先弄清情况时，回到合并前的状态
variants.when_en: When the conflict is too tangled, return to the pre-merge state

use.t: 按 git status 列出的文件，打开冲突文件搜索冲突标记
理解两边意图后保留正确内容，而不是任选一边
删掉全部冲突标记（含 <<<<、======、>>>>）后再 git add 并提交
解决后重新运行项目，确认两边功能都还在

dont.t: 保留任何冲突标记就提交：这些标记不是可运行代码
没有看懂另一边就整段删除：可能丢掉对方的修复
把 git merge --abort 当成冲突解决：它只是返回合并前状态，改动仍未合入
解决冲突时顺手改其他代码，让这次提交混杂无关改动

lessonPractice.title: 主页标题冲突，feature 分支还加了导航。怎样留下正确标题并保留导航？

options.label: 检查标记附近内容，协调标题版本并保留需要的导航，删标记后提交
options.feedback: 对。先读两边的标题和文件上下文；处理冲突区时仍要保留 feature 分支需要的导航，并在提交后重开页面验收。

options.label: 整段选 main 的版本，丢掉 feature 分支的新导航
options.feedback: 标题可以按 main 的写法处理，但整段覆盖会连同 feature 分支新增的导航一起丢掉。

options.label: 整段选 feature 的版本，不再检查 main 上的其他内容
options.feedback: 只选一边也可能抹掉仍需要的主线内容；先查看标记区之外的上下文和新增内容。

en.title: The homepage title conflicts, and the feature branch also adds navigation. How do you keep the right title and preserve the navigation?

options.label: Review the surrounding file, reconcile the title, keep needed navigation, remove markers, then commit
options.feedback: Correct. Read both title versions and the file context; retain the feature branch navigation while resolving the conflict, then reopen the page to verify it.

options.label: Take main's version for the whole section and discard the feature branch navigation
options.feedback: You may choose main's heading, but replacing the whole section would also remove the navigation added by the feature branch.

options.label: Take the feature version for the whole section without checking main's other content
options.feedback: Taking only one side can discard needed main-branch content; review the surrounding lines and additions first.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 合并 feature/new-nav 时 index.html 的标题发生冲突。请先解释 main 和 feature 分别改了什么，保留合理标题与对方新增的导航，以及 main 原有的联系内容；只处理必要差异，删除全部标记后再 add 并完成合并。重新打开页面确认标题、导航都在。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Merging feature/new-nav conflicts in the index.html heading. Explain what main and feature changed; keep an appropriate heading and the other branch's new navigation, along with main's existing contact content. Make only the needed edits, remove all markers, then stage and finish the merge. Reopen the page and check both heading and navigation.
